title: Satan the Accuser
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Satan the accuser seeks to condemn, shame, and crush God’s people by bringing accusations against them. His accusations are answered only by the righteousness, advocacy, and blood of Christ.
summary: Satan the accuser seeks to condemn, shame, and crush God’s people by bringing accusations against them. His accusations are answered only by the righteousness, advocacy, and blood of Christ.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the righteous Advocate of His people. He intercedes for believers and silences every condemning charge against those who belong to Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture presents Satan as an accuser. He charges, condemns, and seeks to use sin, weakness, suffering, and failure to turn people away from confidence in God.

In Zechariah, Satan stands to accuse Joshua, but the Lord rebukes him and provides clean garments. This picture points to the deeper hope that God Himself answers accusation with mercy and cleansing.

Satan’s accusations may contain reminders of real sin, but they lead toward despair rather than repentance and faith. The Spirit convicts to bring sinners to Christ; the accuser condemns to drive them from hope.

Christ is the believer’s answer. No charge can stand against those God has justified. Jesus intercedes, advocates, and keeps His people by His finished work.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many believers know the weight of accusation. Shame, regret, past sin, addiction, failure, and weakness can become weapons used to make them feel beyond grace.

This doctrine teaches believers to distinguish conviction from condemnation. Conviction leads to confession and Christ; accusation leads to hiding and despair.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: When accusation rises, do not answer it with self-defense or denial. Confess what is true, reject what is false, and run to Christ your Advocate. Stand on the Gospel: God justifies, Christ intercedes, and no accusation can overturn His grace.
